content: Homebridge dynamic platform (official template): platform implements DynamicPlatformPlugin; constructor stores Service/Characteristic refs and Map<UUID,PlatformAccessory> cache; registerPlatform in index.ts. configureAccessory(accessory) called per cached accessory on startup -> add to cache map (do NOT register again). On api 'didFinishLaunching' call discoverDevices(): for each device uuid=api.hap.uuid.generate(stableId); if cache hit reuse+new AccessoryHandler(this,accessory); else new api.platformAccessory, set context.device, new AccessoryHandler, api.registerPlatformAccessories(PLUGIN_NAME,PLATFORM_NAME,[acc]). Prune accessories not rediscovered via unregisterPlatformAccessories. Handler sets up Service + Characteristic onGet/onSet; push updates flow back via service.updateCharacteristic(Characteristic.X, value).
